messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: problem with standardized residuals
parts:
The upper triangle of the residual correlation matrix is filled with NA's because they are redundant (you only need the lower triangle). Using things like View(M2(mod, residmat=TRUE)), or if you prefer something better rounded, View(round(M2(mod, residmat=TRUE), 3)). Cheers.

Phil
